claims.text: Egypt has land in Asia, the Sinai Peninsula.
Morocco, Sudan and Libya have no land in Asia.
The Sinai Peninsula lies east of the Isthmus of Suez, where Africa meets Asia, and is usually counted as part of Asia.

claimResults.note: Egypt borders Israel and Palestine, both in Asia; the Sinai Peninsula east of the Suez Canal is that Asian land. The Natural Earth 110m Egypt polygon also has 14 vertices east of the canal (lon 32.7 to 34.9 E, lat 27.7 to 31.2 N), which is Sinai.
No neighbour of the three is in Asia, and none has territory east of the Isthmus of Suez.
